_instructions: One config drives the email capture form on every micro-tool page.
1. Create a free account with an email provider and find the HTML form action URL
it gives you for an embedded form.
2. Paste that URL into formAction below, then run: npm run build && npm run verify
3. Set emailField to the field name your provider expects. Examples:
4. While formAction is empty NO form is rendered anywhere. That is deliberate:
a signup box that cannot deliver an address is worse than no signup box.
DO NOT put an API key or secret in this file. This repository is public and the
site is static, so anything here is served to every visitor. API keys belong in
.env (gitignored) for the operator scripts only, never in a page.
heading: Get one practical money tool a week
blurb: One short email with a tool that does something useful. No sales emails, no daily drip.
note: We store your address with our email provider and never sell it.
